newsitem.title: MEXICO: Santander says interested in acquiring Mexico bank.
newsitem.headline: Santander says interested in acquiring Mexico bank.

text.p: Grupo Santander remains interested in acquiring a Mexican bank to increase its role in the national credit market, a Santander official said Wednesday.
"What we're trying to do is buy a bank in Mexico," Joaquin Avila said at a Mexico City conference called Global Investment Management Forum.
Grupo Santander is a subsidiary of Spain's Banco Santander SA. Avila is the director of what will be the Mexican Banco Santander once a bank is acquired.
Avila said the Spanish Banco Santander has reached the legal limit of participation in the Mexican credit sector established under the North American Free Trade Agreement.
When asked about speculation that Santander was in talks with the Invermexico financial group, Avila said "that's confidential."
"We are open to opportunities," he said. "We're not closed to the idea that (we will buy) Bank A or Bank B."
